paper_metadata.title: A 0.9-V 0.5-A Rail-to-Rail CMOS Operational Amplifier
paper_metadata.abstract: A 0.9-V 0.5A, rail-to-rail CMOS operational amplifier designed with weak inversion techniques is presented. Depletion-mode nMOS transistors buffer a bulk-driven pMOS differential pair to realize wide input dynamic range, while the output stage architecture provides symmetric rail-to-rail output drive through the use of a low-voltage translinear control circuit.
